revenue.definition: money that is made by or paid to a business or an organization

proposal.definition: something (such as a plan or suggestion) that is presented to a person or group of people to consider

delegate.definition: to give a particular job, duty, right, etc. to someone else so that they do it for you

briefing.definition: to give information or instructions to (someone)

pitch.definition: a speech or act that attempts to persuade someone to buy or do something

conversely.definition: in a way that is the opposite of something else

fluctuate.definition: to change level, strength, or value frequently

plummet.definition: to fall suddenly straight down especially from a very high place

steady.definition: not shaking or moving : held firmly in one place or position

leverage.definition: to use something that you already have in order to achieve something new or better

demonstrate.definition: to prove (something) by showing examples of it : to show evidence of (something)

submit.definition: to give (a document, proposal, piece of writing, etc.) to someone so that it can be considered or approved

assign.definition: to give someone a particular job or duty : to require someone to do a particular task

surpass.definition: to be better or greater than (someone or something)

feasible.definition: able to be made, done, or achieved

streamline.definition: to improve the effectiveness of an organization such as a business or government

consensus.definition: a generally accepted opinion or decision among a group of people

decline.definition: to become lower in amount or less in number
